cold_to_warm.description: Lead replies to any text → promote to Warm

warm_to_hot.description: Lead sends listings, asks for payments, or states timeline under 60 days → promote to Hot

hot_to_warm.description: No response for 14+ days → demote to Warm

warm_to_cold.description: No response for 30+ days → demote to Cold

cold_to_dead.description: Completes 90-day Cold track with zero response → Dead
